name: claudectl
description: One local `claudectl` MCP (44 tools) served over LOOPBACK HTTP by ONE daemon per box (claudectl-mcp.service / launchd, installed by cccc/install.sh) — it was a stdio server, which Claude Code forks per open session: 50 procs / 0.65 GB on pbox before a tool call. Claude Max account pool + live 5h/7d limits + pin/switch via the llm.hostbun.cc /api/* control plane, terminal steer/restart across boxes, plugin/marketplace/mcp mgmt, plus skills and the cccc TUI.
